text:
sam: Heads-up — seeing a short burst of invoice_preview gaps ~21:03 UTC (2% of events). Looks tied to the route-priority rollout last night. charge_origin missing on some handoffs.
anya: Ugh. Is that the same shard that had the watermark skew last week?
sam: Seems adjacent. Shard id 12 had high retry fanout. Logs show multiple handoff messages dropped between ingestion service -> enrichment.
leo: Can you paste the failing event sample?
sam: Sure — scrubbed.
sam: ```json
{
  "event_type":"invoice_preview",
  "route_id":"r-prio-v2",
  "shard":12,
  "charge_origin":null,
  "ingest_ts":"2024-10-25T21:03:12Z"
}
```
maria: charge_origin null is the killer for ledger join. If enrichment doesn't attach it we can't attribute tokens -> invoice line.
ops-oncall: I patched a temporary alert to catch >0.5% null charge_origin in preview window. Alert is noisy now but gave us the spike.
anya: What's the current alert smoothing? We should avoid pager for transient microbursts.
ops-oncall: Rule is currently: count_null / total over 5m > 0.5% => page. I propose smoothing to 15m median and add a suppression of pages if total events < 1k in window.
leo: Agreed. Also would be good to add a dedupe heuristic: if multiple handoff retries per session within 2s, treat as single. That reduces rollback noise.
maria: Long-term fix: make enrichment idempotent and populate charge_origin from route fallback metadata on ingest if enrichment is delayed. But short-term: add an enrichment-sidebackoff metric to illuminate queue stalls.
sam: I can add a small proxy tag in the handoff to track retry count: X-handshake-retries. Quick change in proxy config, canary to 5% traffic.
ops-oncall: Can we do canary + shadowing? Canary 5% for enrich-fix + shadow 100% to validate count cleanliness without breaking billing.
anya: For dashboarding: add a new sparklines card (preview null rate) per region + route alias so PMs can see which rollouts correlate.
leo: And an automated recon job to backfill missed charge_origin using session traces for invoices in the last 24h. Might be expensive but limited scope ok.
billing-bot: FYI I flagged affected invoices in preview to avoid auto-commits until backfill completes. :eyes:
sam: Plan: (1) ops updates alert to 15m median + min-volume suppression (ops-oncall), (2) sam will push X-handshake-retries canary 5% + shadowing (sam), (3) leo to prototype backfill job and estimate cost (leo), (4) maria to spec enrichment idempotency RFC (maria). Will sync in 30m in #eng-platform-standup.
anya: +1. Also add a one-off console toggle to pause the route-priority rollout if we see sustained nulls >1% over 30m.
ops-oncall: On it. Rolling smoothing change now, will post status.
sam: Thanks — leaving logs & sample queries in thread. If anyone sees new spikes drop a line here.
